character: Desert circuit with abrasive, high-degradation surface and long straights broken by heavy braking zones. Rewards traction out of slow corners and good brake stability under floodlights.
notes: "sakhir", not "bahrain": ids match the meta filename, and that's what the game adapters resolve this circuit's ordinal to.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.technique: Brake hard from top speed, late apex to open the exit for the run to Turn 2-3
corners.trap: Locking the front under the long straight-line braking zone

corners.name: Turn 4
corners.technique: Patient trail brake, prioritise a clean, early exit over apex speed
corners.trap: Carrying too much entry speed and running wide on exit, losing drive

corners.name: Turn 8
corners.technique: Progressive throttle through the second apex, use full exit width
corners.trap: Getting on power too early and sliding wide before the second apex

corners.name: Turn 10
corners.technique: Late apex, good exit feeds the run to the final sector
corners.trap: Understeer on entry from too much speed carried in

corners.name: Turn 11
corners.technique: Heavy braking, low gear, prioritise exit traction for the following straight
corners.trap: Wheelspin on exit on the abrasive, low-grip surface

corners.name: Turn 14
corners.technique: Late apex, clean exit onto the start/finish straight is the priority
corners.trap: Compromised exit here costs time down the entire straight
